body:
Obvious error per CLAUDE.md, fixed under its standing approval: the glossary's failed-restart-notice entry described the notice as a window the agent-crash-watcher opens on the user's Mac. PR #1299 (merged as 8c48d4d2) changed `nc-systems/handoff/handoff-agent-seat-died-without-session-handoff-restart-watcher.py` so the notice opens as an HTML page in the browser on the Mac; the notice opens in a terminal window on the Mac only when the page cannot be written (`write_notice_page`) or the Mac refuses the page (`show`, exit status 2).

The one changed line, `docs/nedschorus-wiki/nedschorus-glossary.md` line 36, now reads: "the page the agent-crash-watcher opens in the browser on the user's Mac when it cannot restart an agent-seat, with the command to restart it himself; when the page cannot be written or the Mac refuses the page, the notice opens in a terminal window on the Mac instead."

A search of `docs/`, `nc-systems/`, `scripts/` and `.claude/` found no other text that calls the failed-restart-notice a window; the watcher's own uses of "window" describe the terminal-window fallback correctly.

Root cause not fixed: PR #1299 changed what the notice is without updating the glossary entry that defines the notice; nothing ties a glossary definition to the code it describes.

Tests: `run-all-test-suites.py --only-suites-whose-recorded-inputs-changed-since origin/main`: 51 passed, 1 failed of 52. The failure is the known flaky timing case in `scripts/run-codex-task-from-brief-test.py` (a 3-second deadline took 39.1 seconds under load); the suite passed on rerun, and this change cannot affect it.
